## poisoning: what gets ranked above a poisoned review

An intruder is a clean training review among the 30 highest-scored for one
triggered query. The columns say what the intruders have in common with the
query they intrude on. For scale, 50% of clean reviews are labelled positive
and 10% mention a word of the trigger.
